summary.why_the_rest_are_gone: mega.nz hosted most of them and 222 of its file links return -16 (account terminated) or -9; mediafire lost 45 of 152; drive lost 20 of 44. 25 mega FOLDER links are still unknown -- the folder API was not queried, so they may add a few more.
summary.note: mega share urls are fragment-based, so an HTTP HEAD reports a false death for every one; they must be checked through g.api.mega.co.nz or all 280 get written off wrongly.
summary.CORRECTION: The "134 with a live download" figure counts share PAGES that load, not files that can be fetched. An automated pass over all 134 retrieved exactly ONE payload. mediafire now gates its share pages behind a captcha and no longer puts the direct link in the HTML, so its 107 links cannot be scripted and will not be bypassed; 39 more answered with a login wall or a removed-file page; 18 are mega, whose accounts are mostly terminated; 8 returned nothing.
summary.what_is_actually_available: The METADATA is complete for all 487 candidates -- author, photos, post text, and the link. That is enough to build a catalog entry for anything whose payload arrives by another route. The payloads themselves need a human to click through mediafire, or a mirror.
